context.transcript:
Good morning, everyone.
At your seat, you'll find copies of the 20 applications we've received for the open position here in our advertising department.
The applications include a cover letter, resume, and the sample advertisements each candidate has submitted.
Our task today is to choose our top four candidates, and we have this room until 11.
30.
After we make our selections, I'll contact those candidates and schedule their interviews for next week.
Please pay special attention to applicants who can use the latest computer software.
Since most of our ads are designed by computer, this skill will be essential.
context.transcript_translation:
大家早上好。
在您的座位上，您会找到我们收到的 20 个空缺职位的申请表。这些职位是在我们的广告部门的。
这些申请包括求职信、简历以及每位候选人提交的样广告。
我们今天的任务是选出前四名候选人，而且我们有到 11 点的时间。
30。
在我们做出选择后，我会联系这些候选人，并安排他们下周进行面试。
请特别关注那些能使用最新计算机软件的申请者。
因为我们的大部分广告都是用电脑设计的，这项技能将是必不可少的。
